1.question: How Can I Make My Brand Go Viral?
1.answer: When you launch an advertising campaign on Clipshub, your offer instantly becomes visible to thousands of content creators. They will pick up your campaign and promote your brand, allowing you to reach hundreds of millions of potential viewers. You only pay for 100% verified views and can easily track how effective your funnel is.

2.question: What Is the Most Effective Funnel for My Campaign?
2.answer: The most effective funnels focus on achieving the highest possible CTA (cost per action). Don't worry — your dedicated account manager on our platform has extensive experience and will guide you step by step to ensure you get the best possible results.

3.question: How Do I Deposit Funds to Launch My Campaign?
3.answer: We currently support the following payment methods: Bank Transfer, PayPal, Credit Cards, USDT (TRC20), USDT (ERC20), and Bitcoin (BTC).

4.question: How Do I Know the Visits Are Real?
4.answer: Our platform uses a triple-verification process to ensure visit authenticity before you are charged. One verification step is automated, while two additional steps are manually reviewed by our moderators. We are committed to providing the highest quality traffic and content for your brand. Your results are our priority, and we aim to be your long-term growth partner.

5.question: What Is the CPM on Clipshub?
5.answer: You set your own CPM (cost per thousand impressions), based on market supply and demand. Your account manager will help you adjust your campaigns to achieve optimal performance.

6.question: Can I Track My Campaign Results?
6.answer: Absolutely! You can track visits, likes, comments, brand mentions, and clicks through your referral links to monitor conversions and measure success.

7.question: How Quickly Can I Launch My Campaign?
7.answer: With the help of our team, your campaign can go live in under one hour. The process is designed to be simple, fast, and efficient.
